item.text:
### (a) Three posts under 280 characters

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prevent its development. A ban on superintelligence is a necessity, not an optional precaution.

2. We cannot accept a race toward superintelligence. If it is built within the next 20 years, the result will be a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are working for a ban before that catastrophe becomes unavoidable.

3. We want a future for humanity—not a race that ends in mass death. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are calling for a ban on superintelligence.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 109 words

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are working to prevent that outcome—not to soften its description or make peace with its inevitability. We reject the idea that humanity must accept this danger as the price of technological progress. A race toward superintelligence is a race toward catastrophe, and we can choose to stop it. Our task is to turn that choice into policy: a ban on superintelligence. We are building public understanding and pressing for political action because protecting humanity’s future matters more than winning a race we must not run.
